title: Diamond DA42 複材雙發飛機
subcategoryTitle: 民航機與世界航空案例
subcategoryTitleEn: Civil aircraft and world aviation cases
summary: 以DA42複材雙發類型討論複材、雙推進介面和能源帳；雙發不能直接用獨立性乘法取代實際失效分析。十個單元依序進行機制、定量、量測與診斷，每單元可改一個變數比較結果。
summaryEn: Use the DA42 composite-twin type to discuss composite structures, dual-propulsion interfaces and energy accounting; two engines do not justify independence multiplication without failure analysis. Ten units each progress through mechanism, calculation, measurement and diagnosis, with a one-variable comparison.
scope: 公開原理支持的原創航空教學。每個數值均明示為假設模型，非同名機型實際性能、維修手冊、製造工藝、取證判據或飛行操作。任務在模型完成，不提供武器、軍用性能最佳化或真機操作指示。
scopeEn: Original aviation teaching based on public principles. Every numerical example is an explicit hypothetical model, not named-aircraft performance, maintenance data, manufacturing process, certification criterion or flight operation. Tasks run in models, excluding weapons, military-performance optimization and aircraft operating instructions.

stages.title: 系統邊界與現場觀察
stages.description: 以可核對的機制、算例、操作與診斷逐步建立證據。
stages.descriptionEn: Build evidence through mechanisms, worked examples, actions and diagnosis.

steps.title: 複材方向剛性：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Directional composite stiffness: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 複材方向剛性 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Directional composite stiffness and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 沿纖維等應變的混合法則以體積分率加權模數；轉向或橫向受力需不同本構模型。
steps.instructionEn: The longitudinal iso-strain rule of mixtures weights moduli by volume fraction; off-axis or transverse loading requires a different constitutive model.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非Diamond DA42 複材雙發飛機實際性能或製程：Ef=230 GPa，Em=3 GPa，Vf=0.60。式 E1=VfEf+(1−Vf)Em，基準結果 139.2 GPa。適用條件：理想單向、完全黏結且無孔隙，非完整航空鋪層剛性。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not measured performance or a process for Diamond DA42 composite twin aircraft: Ef=230 GPa, Em=3 GPa and fibre volume fraction Vf=0.60. Formula E1=VfEf+(1−Vf)Em gives 139.2 GPa. Conditions: Ideal unidirectional, perfectly bonded and void-free material; not a complete aircraft laminate stiffness.
steps.failure: 把E1用在所有方向會高估橫向與剪切剛性。
steps.failureEn: Using E1 in every direction overestimates transverse and shear stiffness.
steps.check: 比較沿纖維與橫向虛擬拉伸曲線，將鋪層角度和試片方向寫入檔名。
steps.checkEn: Compare longitudinal and transverse virtual tensile curves and encode ply angle and coupon orientation in filenames.

knowledge.title: 複材方向剛性
knowledge.text: 沿纖維等應變的混合法則以體積分率加權模數；轉向或橫向受力需不同本構模型。
knowledge.textEn: The longitudinal iso-strain rule of mixtures weights moduli by volume fraction; off-axis or transverse loading requires a different constitutive model.

knowledge.title: 驗證與操作練習
knowledge.text: 先預測方向，再僅把Vf改成0.55；其餘條件固定。模型結果由 139.2 改為 127.85 GPa。在算式區重算並記下對「複材方向剛性」的判讀，以及仍需要哪個量測才能檢驗假設。
knowledge.textEn: Predict the direction, then Change only Vf to 0.55, holding other conditions fixed. The model changes from 139.2 to 127.85 GPa. Recalculate in the expression lab and record what this means for Directional composite stiffness, plus the measurement still needed to test the assumption.

quiz.question: 哪一項能解釋本單元的工程機制？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement explains this unit’s mechanism?

看到結果符合預期就可省略條件、單位與原始資料。

optionsEn: The longitudinal iso-strain rule of mixtures weights moduli by volume fraction; off-axis or transverse loading requires a different constitutive model.
An expected result allows conditions, units and raw data to be omitted.
Composite elastic modulus is identical in every direction.
quiz.explanation: 沿纖維等應變的混合法則以體積分率加權模數；轉向或橫向受力需不同本構模型。 比較沿纖維與橫向虛擬拉伸曲線，將鋪層角度和試片方向寫入檔名。
quiz.explanationEn: The longitudinal iso-strain rule of mixtures weights moduli by volume fraction; off-axis or transverse loading requires a different constitutive model. Compare longitudinal and transverse virtual tensile curves and encode ply angle and coupon orientation in filenames.

steps.title: 殼體鋪層與厚度圖：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Shell layup and thickness map: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 殼體鋪層與厚度圖 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Shell layup and thickness map and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 總厚度可由每層固化厚度加總；名義厚度不能揭露漏層、重疊或局部樹脂積聚。
steps.instructionEn: Total thickness sums cured-ply thickness; a nominal total cannot reveal missing plies, overlap or local resin pockets.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非Diamond DA42 複材雙發飛機實際性能或製程：n=16層，每層t=0.125 mm。式 h=nt，基準結果 2 mm。適用條件：同厚度假設，只檢查幾何，不證明鋪層方向或固化品質。 長度若以m算出，乘1000轉mm。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not measured performance or a process for Diamond DA42 composite twin aircraft: n=16 plies and cured thickness t=0.125 mm per ply. Formula h=nt gives 2 mm. Conditions: Equal ply thickness, checking geometry only, not orientation or cure quality. Multiply a result in metres by 1000 to report millimetres.
steps.failure: 相同總厚度的錯誤鋪層可能通過單點卡尺檢查。
steps.failureEn: A wrong layup with the same total thickness can pass a single calliper check.
steps.check: 比較鋪層清單、條碼紀錄與網格厚度圖；對厚度相同但方向錯誤的例子另設驗證。
steps.checkEn: Compare ply list, barcode record and a thickness map; separately verify an equal-thickness wrong-orientation case.
